I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I confirmed that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, replacing the Dock 23 she posted earlier. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

My reply says I "updated my notes," but nothing was written down. I don't keep a separate notes file, so the only record is the two thread replies in #central-team. Anyone who reads only the first reply will still see Dock 23.
